chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A man doubted his wudu (ablution) after he had finished the salat (prayer). He said: "He should proceed on the basis of his salat and not repeat it."

key_terms.الْوُضُوءِ: wudu (ablution), the ritual purification before prayer
key_terms.يَمْضِي: continues and proceeds on the basis of what was done

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone doubts his wudu (ablution) after finishing salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt about wudu (ablution) after completing the salat (prayer). If the doubt arises only after the prayer has been finished, the person proceeds on the basis of validity and does not repeat the prayer.
